port_requirements: Select a compatible transient incompressible solver and translate Foundation14 dictionaries/property filenames as needed by the selected OpenCFD/GPU branch.

Adapt coded fvModel wrapper to the branch source API, such as fvOptions/codedSource if that is the supported interface; verify actual callback, registration and sign/density conventions rather than only renaming a file.
Recompile source and dependencies for the selected branch/compiler; existing Foundation14 dynamic-code/shared libraries cannot be assumed ABI-compatible.
Preserve finite-cylinder cell fractions, global normalization, velocity/work weighting, force direction, modeled electrical-power budget and controller reset/lifecycle.
Use branch-supported GPU iteration and device-safe allocations/captures for offloaded source/reduction kernels; ordinary host forAll loops are not automatically GPU kernels.
If host source callbacks remain, establish synchronization and managed-memory correctness and measure transfer/migration overhead.

Concurrent processing of different rotors must handle shared source cells in overlapping disks safely; keep rotor accumulation serial, use cell-owned accumulation, or supply suitable atomic/reduction semantics.
Validate frozen-case force/power/field/continuity equivalence and measure full elapsed time including setup, startup, mapping/decomposition and output before production adoption.
